Sir, if you would be kind enough to repost the quinoa recipe?

You'll have to play with it because there are different types of quinoa and I think climate has a little to do with it, too. I've found that anywhere between 1 part quinoa to 2 parts water, and 1 part quinoa to 1.5 parts water, can work. This recipe was a godsend when it was hard to stand or use my arms. I started keeping spices beside the microwave so that it's easier.

  • 1/2 cup quinoa

  • 1 cup water

Put together in bowl. Mix with fork. Cover with anything you have, preferably something that isn't porous (container lid > paper towel). Microwave on high for 5-6 minutes.

After microwaving for ~6 minutes, put spices and a pat of butter on it (butter optional but highly recommended). Fluff and mix it up with your fork. Put back in microwave, covered, and cook at HALF power for anywhere between 3-7 minutes. If it starts to crackle or develop a weird scent, stop it immediately. I found that it was usually perfect at 5 minutes. Uncover and let sit for a while to steam off.
